description: Source code for Windows-specific implementation of the Port interface in a web testing framework, including crash handling, environment setup, and build checks.

classes.name: WinPort
classes.description: Windows-specific implementation of the Port interface, handling crash reporting, environment setup, and build verification.

methods.name: determine_full_port_name
methods.description: Determines the full port name based on host platform and options.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WinPort instance, setting up version, dump reader, and crash service.

methods.name: additional_driver_flag
methods.description: Returns additional command-line flags for the driver, including crash reporting options.

methods.name: check_httpd
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP server (Apache) is properly configured, including registry checks.

methods.name: _check_reg
methods.description: Checks or sets registry entries for CGI script execution.

methods.name: setup_test_run
methods.description: Prepares environment and crash service for a test run.

methods.name: clean_up_test_run
methods.description: Cleans up crash service after a test run.

methods.name: setup_environ_for_server
methods.description: Sets environment variables needed for server operation, including Cygwin setup.

methods.name: check_build
methods.description: Verifies build requirements and crash service availability.

methods.name: operating_system
methods.description: Returns the OS name 'win'.

methods.name: relative_test_filename
methods.description: Converts absolute filename to relative path within tests directory.

methods.name: uses_apache
methods.description: Determines if Apache is used based on options.

methods.name: path_to_apache_config_file

methods.name: _path_to_driver

methods.name: _path_to_crash_service
methods.description: Returns path to crash service executable.

methods.name: _path_to_image_diff
methods.description: Returns path to image diff executable.
